grandparents_cupboard.reason: Flour, eggs, ricotta, milk, butter, honey, yoghurt and fresh clementines are all plain whole foods with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including ricotta and Greek yoghurt, is an everyday item at Tesco at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a bowl, a whisk and a frying pan, and frying pancakes is well within a confident beginner's reach.

works.reason: 200g flour, 2 eggs, 250g ricotta and 200ml milk make a sensible thick batter for about 12 to 16 pancakes, and 4 sliced clementines warmed with honey and juice make a good topping for four.

honest_times.reason: Thirty minutes of active work is believable for mixing the batter, frying it in batches, and warming the fruit at a standard pace.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, nothing unlisted appears, and each name matches its id.

seasonal_feel.reason: Warm clementines suit an early November morning, and with six of them providing the zest, the juice and the topping they are the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English that a neighbour would follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Ricotta, eggs, yoghurt and plenty of fruit make this a proper, protein-rich breakfast rather than just sugar and starch.
